name: Velana International Airport

permits.v: The Maldives CAA takes general aviation permit applications in three categories: IP international private (tourism, medevac), IT technical stop, IF international ferry. Velana is among the airports it lists for general aviation. Aircraft registered 4X may not fly in or out, and direct flights between Israel and the Maldives are not permitted. A foreign operator may fly up to 9 non-scheduled flights under a One-off Approval, or until the CAA decides its application if sooner. No lead time is stated.
permits.quote: Aircrafts with ICAO registration (4X) are not allowed to fly in and out of the Maldives. ... Direct Flights are not permitted between Israel and Maldives (vice versa). ... A foreign operator may perform up to 9 (nine) non-scheduled flights from the date of the first flight ... under a One-off Approval or until MCAA has taken a decision on the application, whichever comes sooner.
